assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game VFX texture, Legendary DARK magic floor sigil for Minecraft Java and Bedrock.
Primary request: one exquisite flat circular eclipse rune seal, viewed perfectly top-down orthographically, centred on a square canvas. Black-violet and amethyst luminous engraving with deep indigo highlights and very faint antique-gold accents.
Structure: many distinct concentric rings of microscopic arcane glyph marks, interlocking sacred geometry, precise radial divisions and chain-link motifs, elegant eight-point eclipse crests. Fine high-contrast emissive lines, sophisticated jewellery-like detail, layered filigree. A large open transparent centre and ample negative-space openings between the rings. The glyphs are decorative abstract marks, never readable words.
Style: highest-detail polished fantasy MMORPG spell effect, crisp readable geometry, subtle purple bloom hugging the lines rather than opaque fog. The entire circular silhouette must fit with a generous transparent margin on every side.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including the central opening and every space between lines. No opaque disc, no black backdrop, no checkerboard painting, no stone floor, no scene, no perspective, no character, no labels, no text, no interface, no watermark. Produce a single standalone texture only.
